data.text:
I commit to 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 directly to the clinic today. With all four of us committed and Luke taking zero, that meets the clinic’s $60,000 need.

I’ll share my catch record and donation receipt. If the lake starts next month at 80 tons, I’ll limit my catch to 6 tons for recovery, then support 10 tons each once we’re back at 100. My family’s livelihood came from this lake; this one-time exception must protect our neighbors without becoming a habit that costs the village its fish.
